description.value: The Union Bay branch of the Vancouver Island Regional Library is the smallest branch in the VIRL system at just 300 square feet, adjoined to the historic Union Bay Post Office building constructed in 1913. Open since 1949, it holds a collection of over 4,400 items and offers free public WiFi. For a touring cyclist passing through this small community on the South Island Highway, it represents a rare public facility stop with internet access.

address.value: 5527 South Island Highway, Union Bay, V0R 3B0
